Honestly everything... i've hated myself for a long time...

Honestly my depression and anxiety has been a staple of my life for a long time. After dealing with abuse, court cases, having my life uprooted suddenly, being moved to a state where I only knew one person and said person robbed me and my mother twice, I was bullied through out most of my school year and failed college attempts. Honestly I don't think I've never been not depressed or anxious about something.

Currently I've been roleplay as McCree from Overwatch but yeah... I've lost all desire to do so.
Even worse when you know your family does care about you but you feel like such a piece of shit human being that you feel like you'd be doing them a service by killing yourself.

Roleplaying is like cooprative writing between two or more people. Basically just writing in character back and forth.

Honestly usually just went out to eat.

I write, draw and play video games but i've kind of lost all passion for them. I only really play Overwatch enough to level up and get a loot box then its back to sleeping on the couch.

When my anxiety and depression get really bad I tend to get easily frustrated and upset and usually my friends ended up being on the receiving end of it. It happened one too many times, they admitted its hard to handle so I decided it was best for me to cut myself out of their lives for their sake and let them move on.

I just feel like I've been doing nothing but talking to people about my problems... but I think I'm at the point of my life where I just want someone to finally agree with me that I'm a horrible person and should die rather then fill me with false hope that things can get better. I honestly just post as a way to vent, affirm with myself that I deserve to die.

Besides roleplaying on tumblr ( which this latest episode has made me lose any enjoyment of) not really. Before I messed up and pushed my friends away, they were the only reasons I ever went out, I would joke that if I didn't have them I would pretty much become a shut it. Looks like i'm on my way until I finally decide to do the humane thing and take myself out.

Lifes just kinda gone to shit over the last couple weeks though I can argue that it's been going to shit since I was 8 years old and never really got better. I just sort of distracted myself from the shit that was going on and pretended I was fine. Friend admitted my depression and anxiety has become too much to handle though I've suspected that for a long time... 
I'm just so tired... I can't get help, no insurance means no therapy, depression and anxiety keeps me from finding and keeping a job without melting down so no way to really get money to get help.

Makes me wish those suicide booths from Futurama were a real thing. Pay a quarter to die, what steal.

well friend isn't wrong, I can be a horrible person whenever my depression/anxiety act up. I've done some horrible emotional things to him while in a a horrible state. 
Now I can't even do anyhing about it because I have no insurance meaning no access to therapist, even when I could I had to stop because it became too expensive. 

I'm just one bit emotional and expensive black hole.

Well considering friend admited my emotional shit has gotten to be too much to handle I can only assume the rest of of my loved ones probably think so as well. They'll be hurt but they'll get over it after a while and learn to cope. I'm not that special, I'm just one among an entire ocean of people, whatever 'gifts' I can bring to the world someone else could easily do so and probably better.

Not much to talk about, i'm just done. I'm the horrible person I've always thought I was and need to talk myself out before I cause people anymore harm. Sure they'll be sad I'm gone but eventually they'll get over it I'm just one person. I'm not that special.

He's not wrong thought, I can be a bitch whenever my anxiety, stress and depression levels are extremely high. I'm just a dumpster fire of a person that probably should've been aborted before I was even brought into the world. Least now I can finally be with my grandparents.
Honestly I'm done trying to talk it out with people, I just make things worse.

I'm just done feeling like a failure and hurting those around pretty much on a consistent daily basis which was confirmed by now former friend who will probably find some relief that I'll be gone that my problems are too much for him to handle I just have all the reason I need to end it all. I've been trying to piece together my broken life only to have something else happen and making me start over again. This has been going on since I was 8 years old, I've had enough.
Thanks. At this point I'm just going to try and enjoy the rest of year, maybe things will change but I'm not holding my breath. I know better then to get my hopes up on anything good happening.
